After calling the API to trigger a report, the Skai query will begin processing. The runtime may vary between a few seconds and an hour, depending on the scope of the report and the amount of data returned.

This API call is designed to be run at recurring polling intervals so that you can inquire from the Skai API when the report is ready. A best practice would be to run the report manually a few times to figure out the average run time before deciding on the polling interval you will use.

items.docs:
Two variants depending on parameters provided:
- `profileId` only → lists all ESPs for the profile (`GET /api/v1/external-reports/{profileId}`)
- `profileId` + `espId` → returns full config for one ESP (`GET /api/v1/external-reports/config/{profileId}/{espId}`)

Pass `espId = -1` to retrieve a blank default config (useful as a template when creating a new provider).
